name: optimate-make-cli
description: CLI to fetch, analyze, edit, build, and push Make.com scenario blueprints

scripts.postinstall:
echo '
  make-fixer installed successfully!

  Get started:
    make-fixer login --token <your-make-api-token>

  Claude Code skill (optional):
    git clone https://github.com/idokraicer/optimate-plugins.git /tmp/optimate-plugins && cp -r /tmp/optimate-plugins/plugins/make-fixer/skills/make-fixer .claude/skills/ && rm -rf /tmp/optimate-plugins
'
